name: MIGO calCalc - Personalny Kalkulator Kalorii
description:
MIGO.calCalc is a fast, private, and intuitive calorie and macronutrient tracker powered by Gemini AI, designed to make food logging as effortless as having a conversation or recognizing meals from Photo

Key Features:
- Natural Input & Voice Support: Log meals using natural text or voice commands—no need to search through tedious food databases.
- Comprehensive Macro Tracking: Track calories, protein, fats, carbs, and sugars with clean, interactive charts.
- Built-in Calendar & History: Easily view, edit, and organize your logged meals across days.
- Privacy & Local Data Control: All your nutrition data remains stored locally on your device with full export/import capabilities.
- Modern PWA Design: Fast, responsive interface with Dark Mode support and multi-language capabilities (English & Polish).

Simplify your nutrition logging and hit your health goals with MIGO.cal!
